record.body:
## Description

Tier-2 suite failure in this module. Fix so the README full suite passes at phase head. Do not reopen done tasks.

## Approach

1. Reproduce with: uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k 'running_row_status_shows_its_running_time or footer_has_no_palette or detail_related_panel_lists_related_records'
2. Failures: test_running_row_status_shows_its_running_time[120]; test_footer_has_no_palette_and_every_binding_fits_at_60_columns; test_detail_related_panel_lists_related_records[size1-_open_by_click]
3. Fix tests and/or product code as appropriate; keep changes on phase/tiered-verification worktree.
4. Also ensure worktree `.tier2/` is gitignored so tier-2 runs record a clean head SHA (not dirty).
record.subject: fix-test_dashboard_app
